costumes.name: Banquet Witch
costumes.description:
Harran costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

lines.text: What are you looking at? Get back to work!
My crow only obeys my commands. Isn't she a good little birdie?
There is nothing on this planet more important than me. I can do as I please.
You've brought life to this visage of mine. I'm quite pleased about that.
That's the spirit! Keep it up and I'll dote on you even further!
So you want to bring me to the Surface again?
Huh. It's so boring. Did you bring me up here just to ignore me?
Huh. I'm bored stiff. Do you want me to make you some witch soup?
Walking is such an inconvenience. Why don't you carry me instead?
This dump is a little better off now that I've arrived.
Wings of Victory? They suit me.
You ought to thank your lucky stars that I'm around.
Yes, do my bidding, just like that.
Wow, I'm gaining strength!
Excellent. This will suffice for now.
I accept your offering.
I suppose this gift is satisfactory.
Great. Please go on.
Don't forget how kind I've been to you.
I'm more and more satisfied with you, Follower.
I won't soon forget how you placed your faith in me.
You need me?
Tell me about it.
I made a special trip here just for you.
Time to hunt.
Time to kill.
Feeble-minded swine, this is the end of the line!
My crow thirsts for blood.
You had it coming.
Things are finally starting to get interesting.
Reload!
It's my turn.
I hereby sentence you to death.
I will burn you all to the ground!
Hmph.
I grow weary of these childish games.
Are you dead yet?
Urgh!
Uh.
Ugh.
Foul creatures, I'll finish you off after I take a break.
Yet another victory I brought for you. No need to thank me.
Now that I think of it, I've never shared a drink with you before.
Let's raise our glasses.
Wouldn't you say I'm the most beautiful girl at this party?

Would you like to have a drink?
You should know I never say such things, not to anyone.

Even if this drink could have been spiked, you would still down it without a second thought, right?
That's why I like you.
You and I shall be the highlight of the party.
You made me wait. You'll have to make it up to me somehow.

Don't make me wait too long. 
Summoning me and then leaving me alone is a privilege granted only to you.
This is a rather... simple place.
Prepare a few locations that will suit me.
Do you not have a carriage for my use?
I know it's a lot to take in, but you must endure it.
Seeing you work for me is quite pleasant.
The gap between you and me will widen even further.
I've become stronger.
You truly do know what I enjoy. I'm most pleased.
I'll reward you with more love and care.
I wouldn't mind seeing this kind of charm more often.
You may stand beside me. Come here.
I'm beginning to like you more and more.
How about having a party just for two next time?
I'll cooperate just this once.
Did you call me?
Don't rush me.
You'll regret this.
Crows, it's mealtime.
Such arrogance. Such insignificance.
Seems like you have a death wish.
Wait a minute.
Reloading.
This is taking longer than I expected.
My crow thirsts for blood.
Let's throw an executioner's ball.
Struggle all you wish. You will die in agony.
How pitiful.
What's next?
I would like to wrap this up.
Ow!
Ugh.
*Cough*
This is a special outfit, and I don't wish to see it ruined. I will stay out of this for the time being.

There's no need to get excited.
Our victory was a foregone conclusion.
